dish.title: Basque Hake in Salsa Verde with Peas and Potatoes

recipe_version.title: Basque Hake in Salsa Verde with Peas and Potatoes
recipe_version.description: Hake fillets gently cooked in a Basque green sauce of olive oil, garlic, white wine, and plenty of parsley, thickened lightly with flour, with sweet peas, served over boiled potatoes.

ingredients.name: hake fillets
ingredients.note: about 6 oz each; cod is the same-shopping swap

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Peel and cut the potatoes. Slice the garlic very thin, chop the parsley, and cut the lemon into wedges. Season the fish with 1/2 tsp salt.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.body: Put the potatoes in a 4-quart pot with 6 cups water and 1 tsp salt. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook until tender, about 15 minutes, then drain. This runs inside steps 3 to 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the green sauce
steps.body: Warm the olive oil and garlic together in a 12-inch skillet over medium-low until the garlic turns pale gold, about 4 minutes. Stir in the flour for 1 minute. Whisk in the wine and simmer 2 minutes, then add 1 cup water and three-quarters of the parsley and simmer until lightly thickened, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Cook the fish
steps.body: Lay the hake in the sauce and add the peas around it. Cover and simmer gently, shaking the pan now and then so the sauce stays smooth, until the fish is opaque and reads 145 F, about 8 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Scatter the remaining parsley and spoon sauce over the fish.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon potatoes into shallow bowls, set a fillet on top, ladle over the sauce and peas, and add a lemon wedge.
